points.title: Profile overview
points.text:
Title: Profile overview
Category: About
Facts: Sachin Ved Gupta is a McMaster University Software Engineering Co-op student focused on applied AI systems, AI agents, machine-learning infrastructure, simulations, developer tools, and product-oriented software. His recurring pattern is to take messy operational or human context, model it clearly, and build software that helps people make decisions or complete work. He has completed software engineering and data science internships at Nokia, Nokia Bell Labs, Shopify, Zipline, and Microsoft. He is strongest when connecting ML or agent technology to a concrete workflow rather than building a model demo in isolation.
Entities: Sachin Ved Gupta, McMaster University, Microsoft, Zipline, Shopify, Nokia Bell Labs, Nokia
Themes: applied AI, agent systems, ML infrastructure, simulation, developer tools
Related records: career-throughline, skills-agent-systems, skills-ml-systems

points.title: Career throughline
points.text:
Title: Career throughline
Category: About
Facts: Across Sachin's work, the same design instinct appears: model a complex environment, expose the right interface, and let software help a person act. At Nokia, that meant infrastructure provisioning and diagnosis. At Nokia Bell Labs, it meant grounding ML and agent systems in engineering knowledge and operational signals. At Shopify, it meant production recommendation infrastructure and debugging. At Zipline, it meant simulating an autonomous delivery network and making the simulator accessible through natural language. At Microsoft, it meant improving PowerPoint Web boot reliability and prototyping repeatable browser-agent testing. Student work extends the same pattern through browser agents, autonomous drones, educational agents, cloud provisioning, and AI-assisted storytelling.
Entities: Nokia, Nokia Bell Labs, Shopify, Zipline, Microsoft, InterfaceAI, LearnBridge
Themes: systems thinking, operational workflows, AI agents, decision support
Related records: experience-microsoft, experience-zipline, experience-shopify, experience-nokia-bell-labs, experience-nokia

points.title: Microsoft — Software Engineering Intern
points.text:
Title: Microsoft — Software Engineering Intern
Category: Experience
Facts: At Microsoft in Vancouver from May through August 2026, Sachin worked as a Software Engineering Intern on the PowerPoint Web Performance team. He shipped boot and reliability fixes involving canvas centering, off-slide shape visibility, scroll behavior, comments-pane layout reservation, and visual popping. He also built a PR-aware browser-agent testing prototype that compared baseline and changed builds across realistic tasks and environments, producing recordings and reproducible issue reports. Across a seven-day run, the work identified 17 optimizations; his internship results included 21 percent faster boot time and 13 production fixes.
Entities: Microsoft, PowerPoint Web, Jank Hunter
Themes: web performance, browser agents, developer tools, reliability, testing
Related records: career-throughline, project-interfaceai, skills-agent-systems
points.source: Career profile and public-safe Microsoft case study

points.title: Zipline — Data Science Intern
points.text:
Title: Zipline — Data Science Intern
Category: Experience
Facts: From January through April 2026, Sachin worked as a Data Science Intern at Zipline. He built a natural-language Codex workflow around an operations simulator: the agent could generate configurations, run scenarios, return charts, explain results, and suggest follow-up analysis. Under that interface, he built an extensible discrete-event simulation of autonomous-delivery operations, modelling aircraft, charging docks, workers, partners, event timing, demand, weather, and failures. He calibrated the simulation with historical data and built validation tooling for throughput, timing, utilization, and bottleneck diagnosis. The project combined an LLM agent with rigorous simulation, data calibration, developer tooling, visualization, and cross-functional decision support.
Entities: Zipline, Codex, AI agent, autonomous delivery
Themes: AI agents, LLM tools, simulation, data science, agent interface, operations research, validation
Related records: career-throughline, skills-agent-systems, skills-backend-systems
points.source: Career profile and confidentiality-safe Zipline case study

points.title: Shopify — Software Engineering Intern
points.text:
Title: Shopify — Software Engineering Intern
Category: Experience
Facts: From September through December 2025, Sachin worked in Shopify's Recommendations Infrastructure and Shop app context. He built systems for recommendation relevance, production ML inference and streaming, debugging, and multi-tier caching using Triton, Apache Flink, Kafka, GCP, Bigtable, and DSPy. He distilled a relevancy judge to a one-billion-parameter model for more than ten million recommendations, built recommendation debugging used by more than 80 engineers, and created local-to-remote-to-Bigtable caching that made an advertised-product filtering path 11 times faster.
Entities: Shopify, Shop app, Triton, Apache Flink, Kafka, GCP, Bigtable, DSPy
Themes: recommendation systems, ML infrastructure, stream processing, caching, developer tools
Related records: career-throughline, skills-ml-systems, skills-backend-systems
